🌍 Welcome to Find The Rocks! 🪨✨

A fun Find The style game where you explore, search, and collect all the hidden rocks across the map!

👍 Like the game and ⭐ Favorite it to show support!
👥 Join our Group for exclusive updates, codes, and sneak peeks!

🔥 More updates coming very soon – new rocks, secrets, and challenges await… can you collect them all?
